entries.text: 你好呀～你好～[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_first_00

entries.text: 我来自学院，\n是负责教生物的吉尼亚～[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_first_01

entries.text: 哇～[VAR 0x0100(0000)]。\n最近我们总是见面啊～[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp01_00

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]你现在\n是在这边交换留学，对吧～？[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp01_01

entries.text: 我身为你的班主任！\n也来这里看看你过得如何～[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp01_02

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]，\n在蓝莓学园，你有什么\r\n非常努力去做的事吗～？[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp01_03

entries.text: 宝可梦对战！
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp01_select_01

entries.text: 收集图鉴！
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp01_select_02

entries.text: 交朋友！
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp01_select_03

entries.text: 冠军级就是不一样～！\c\n看来你即使在对战强校也会发挥实力，\n我好高兴～[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp01_04

entries.text:
哇～
那真是太令我高兴了～\c
你在这边也在努力
嘿呀地扔球出去啊！
……是这个意思吧～！[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp01_04b

entries.text:
哇～你交到很多
新朋友了吗～？\c
下次一定要把他们
也介绍给老师我认识啊～[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp01_04c

entries.text: 和夏令营不同，\n这次你是自己一个人来留学。\r\n我本来还挺担心你的……[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp01_05

entries.text: 但是[VAR 0x0100(0000)]你看起来过得很开心，\n真是太好了～！[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp01_06

entries.text: 对了，[VAR 0x0100(0000)]。\n你在生态巨蛋用的是\r\n什么样的图鉴App呢～？[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp02_00

entries.text: 蓝莓图鉴！
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp02_select_01

entries.text: 你要看看吗？
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp02_select_02

entries.text: 哇～！这难道是改良了\n我的图鉴App～！？[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp02_01

entries.text: 我的App是开放源代码的，\n因此可以自由地添加要素……[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp02_02

entries.text: 做出这个蓝莓图鉴的人……\n是叫席蓝？[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp02_03

entries.text: 咦～？这个人写代码的风格和\n克拉韦尔校长很像啊～[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp02_04

entries.text: 我好像在哪儿听过这个名字，\n嗯～是谁来着～？[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp02_05

entries.text: ……改得很好啊。\n谢谢你告诉我～[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp02_06

entries.text: 我也把蓝莓图鉴\n加进图鉴App了～[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp03_01

entries.text: 太好了！
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp03_select_01

entries.text: 我们一样了！
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp03_select_02

entries.text: 是的～！而且蓝色的设计\n也很帅气～[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp03_02

entries.text: 嘻嘻……\n我们变一样了～[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp03_02b

entries.text: 我想完成图鉴，\n于是就在生态巨蛋里到处逛，\r\n真是非～常令我激动啊～[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp03_03

entries.text: 值得关注的是巨蛋的设计！\n想出来的人实在是太厉害了～[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp03_04

entries.text: 各种各样的宝可梦\n都舒舒服服地生活在这里。[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp03_05

entries.text: 如果不是足够了解宝可梦的生态，\n是做不出这样的设计的～[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_sp03_06

entries.text: 看来直到完成图鉴为止，\n必须得常～常到巨蛋来才行呀～[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_trade_01_00

entries.text: 要收集图鉴，\n交换宝可梦也是一种好方法～[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_trade_01_01

entries.text: 机会难得，\n你要不要和我交换宝可梦呢～？[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_trade_01_02

entries.text: 我好高兴啊～\n那我就选溶食兽咯～\r\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]，你呢～？[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_trade_01_03

entries.text:
你选[VAR 0x0101(0001)]啊，真有意思～
它可是魅力十足的宝可梦～\c
真的很谢谢你
和我交换宝可梦～[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_trade_01_04

entries.text: 那就用[VAR 0x0100(0000)]的[VAR 0x0101(0001)]和\n我的溶食兽交换，确定吗～？[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_trade_02_00

entries.text: 无法使用初训家不是自己的\n宝可梦进行交换。
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_trade_02_01

entries.text: 无法使用稀有宝可梦\n进行交换。
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_trade_02_02

entries.text: 无法使用异色宝可梦\n进行交换。
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_trade_02_03

entries.text:
同行宝可梦只有１只的话，
是无法交换的哦～\c
等你带着２只以上的宝可梦，
我们再来交换吧～[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_trade_03_00

entries.text: 你可以慢慢考虑，\n不着急的～[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_trade_03_01

entries.text: 哇哦～[VAR 0x0100(0000)]，\n你要和我交换宝可梦吗～？[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_trade_04_00

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]，看你这表情，\n应该是想对战想到心痒痒了吧～？[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_talkto_00

entries.text: 咦？不好意思～\n是我搞错了～[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_cancel_00

entries.text: 当然没问题了～！\c\n偶尔能在你面前\n好好表现一下也不错呀～！[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_battlestart_00

entries.text: [EMPTY 62]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_battlestart_01

entries.text: 嘻嘻，真服了你～\n我不是[VAR 0x0100(0000)]你的对手呀～[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_battleend_win_00_00

entries.text: 我真的非～常喜欢\n看到[VAR 0x0100(0000)]你的成长～[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_battleend_win_00_01

entries.text: 今后我也会时时刻～刻\n都为你加油的～[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_battleend_win_00_02

entries.text: 啊，可以的话请收下这个，\n是和我同款的眼镜～[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_battleend_win_00_03

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]从吉尼亚老师那里\n获得了[VAR 0xFF00(0008)]六边形眼镜（玳瑁花纹）[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]！
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_reward_00

entries.text: 嘻嘻，我输了～\n你真的很厉害啊～[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_battleend_win_01_00

entries.text: 如果你还愿意的话，\n就随时来找我吧～[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_battleend_win_01_01

entries.text:
我偶尔也是
会努力一把的～\c
如果老师我表现得还不错，
那就太好了～[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_battleend_lose_00_00

entries.text:
生态巨蛋真是
非～常有意思～\c
有好多在帕底亚
见不到的宝可梦啊～[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_randomtalk_00

entries.text:
最近我能在各个地区来往，
真的很开心～\c
移动时只要发一会儿呆，
就立刻能到目的地，轻松得很～[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_randomtalk_01

entries.text:
我竟然穿着凉鞋
就来了别人的学校～\c
要是被克拉韦尔校长看到，
我可能又要挨骂了～[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_randomtalk_02

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]的[VAR 0x0101(0001)]\n是非～常有个性的宝可梦～！\r\n我很期待它的成长～[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_randomtalk_03

entries.text:
我交换给你的溶食兽
可是个很有意思的孩子哦～！\c
因为它是贪吃鬼，
所以会早早就把树果吃掉。[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_ecology_randomtalk_04
